items.text: Website Help threads hold ONE reply at a time — a new reply from the app (or Telegram) replaces the last one in the customer's thread. A full back-and-forth history is a future upgrade, only if you want it.

Intake server update awaiting upload — Dev Studio Creator v3: action requests + sign-packages endpoints (server/src/server.js, server/src/store.js, server/tests/console.test.js). The 🙋 Request buttons and 🔒 private signing packages go live on upload; everything else in the app already works. Files are listed in Muse's report.
G-1 fix: add the missing 'validator' build key to the intake validator (validate.js) so Validator Launch Kit orders validate instead of being refused.
Open price decision: the Full Intensity Pack — $50 proposed, waiting on your yes.
Launch day: deploy the generators service and set its PUBLIC_BASE_URL.
Launch day: deploy the Token Factory closed; you paste FACTORY_MNEMONIC / STUDIO_WALLET / FEE_ULUNA yourself, then FACTORY_OPEN=true and FACTORY_INTAKE_SETTLE=true.
Launch day: run the intake via automated.js with FULFILLMENT_OPEN=true to arm fulfillment. Flipping it back is the one-switch halt.
Launch day: USTC and any extra payment options stay closed until launch — LUNC is the working rail until then.
Validator Launch Kit card: the 17 non-English overlays still say 'your own server' — the translation pass is your call.
